caption: The drawing depicts a single spur, primarily composed of metal and leather. The main body of the spur is metallic with a silvery-gray coloration and features a twisted, grooved design on the arms. At the rear end, there is a large, multi-pointed rowel (wheel) with a central hub, rendered in the same metallic tone. The part of the spur that would rest against the heel is fitted with a decorated leather covering in a deep brownish-red color, edged with a lighter border and embossed with an oval-shaped pattern near the edge. Attached to this leather section is a circular decorative element, containing alternating wedges of red and black around a central metallic button. The composition places the spur centered on a light beige background with no other objects present, and the drawing is rendered in realistic detail with shadows giving a three-dimensional effect.
title: Spur
